hook: Naga's entire executive career was built inside two companies that run some of the largest real-time systems on Earth, LinkedIn and Uber, rising internally at Uber over eleven years to become CTO of a platform operating across cities, countries, and hundreds of millions of users.
name: Praveen Neppalli Naga

quote.text: Scaling systems is often easier than scaling organizations. Data is more important than models when it comes to AI. Speed and clarity beat perfection in most real-world decisions.
quote.context: Praveen Neppalli Naga, personal LinkedIn profile summary

reading.body:
Praveen Neppalli Naga reached the top technical role at Uber in December 2025 after spending his entire executive career inside two companies that run real-time systems at planetary scale, LinkedIn and Uber, without changing employers for eighteen years.

The career arc is almost entirely internal. He joined LinkedIn in 2008, spent seven years there rising to Senior Engineering Manager, then joined Uber in 2015 at Senior Engineering Manager level and spent eleven more years moving upward through Senior Director, Vice President, and two successive CTO roles before reaching company-wide CTO. The pattern is one of compounding institutional knowledge rather than lateral movement across the industry. His five patents sit in indexing, analytics, and job-matching, which are the unglamorous infrastructure problems that determine whether a large consumer platform actually works under load.

His stated position, drawn from his LinkedIn summary, is that data matters more than models in production AI. For an organization whose thesis connects AI capability to what runs beneath it, that framing is worth noting: it locates competitive advantage in the plumbing, the real-time data pipelines and indexing systems, rather than in model architecture alone. The data here covers his titles, timeline, and attributed views, but says nothing about Uber's specific infrastructure investments, energy footprint, or compute strategy, so no inference about those is warranted.
